label: Full sharp ordinary Hadwiger
scope_summary: h(G)>=chi(G) for all finite simple graphs, with no restrictions.
uncertainty: Contemporary primary papers call the ordinary conjecture open. September 2026 search revealed no checked resolution; this is a cutoff snapshot, not a completeness proof of the literature.

label: First unresolved fixed minor order t=7
uncertainty: SRC-0013 states cases only through t=6 known. SRC-0025 is a partial result, not a solution; original paper unchecked. No claim that t=7 is the hardest full-conjecture target.

label: Linear Hadwiger
scope_summary: An absolute C with chi(G)<=Ct for every K_t-minor-free G and every t.
uncertainty: The checked small-graph transfer has constants and establishes an equivalence of linear goals, not a sharp-coloring transfer. Resolve OPEN-0008 before asserting the current record bound.

label: Ordinary Hadwiger with alpha(G)<=2
scope_summary: Exact h(G)>=chi(G) in this class; the necessary half-order bound h(G)>=ceil(n/2) is also a major open target.
uncertainty: Odd counterexamples do not settle ordinary alpha<=2. Do not identify the half-order inequality with the full class conjecture without checking an equivalence theorem.

label: Sharp fractional relaxation
scope_summary: chi_f(G)<=h(G); equivalently sharp (t-1) fractional colors for K_t-minor-free graphs.
uncertainty: Checked primary baseline is the factor-two theorem; dedicated 2026 fractional-frontier search remains a freshness gap. No current exhaustive-status claim.

label: Sharp triangle-free ordinary Hadwiger
scope_summary: Remove the constant gap for all triangle-free graphs, including unrestricted maximum degree.
uncertainty: January 2026 paper explicitly calls this open. Its bounded-degree hypothesis cannot be discarded.

label: Uniform linear coloring without odd K_t minors
scope_summary: Whether an absolute Ct upper bound holds in the odd-minor-free class.
uncertainty: Asymptotically equivalent to ordinary linear coloring within factor 2. The exact odd strengthening is false, so it is not an open sharp target.

label: Verify the September 2026 Lin manuscript
scope_summary: Recover and directly inspect arXiv:2609.08713, including precise hypotheses, version, theorem and proof status.
uncertainty: All direct retrieval attempts failed. Treat discovery abstract as a lead only.
